body_sagittal.label: 2-D cut of the 3-D mesh. Flow on it is a 2-D proxy, not 3-D aerodynamics of the fish.
body_sagittal.plane: y = 0 (midsagittal) through body + dorsal + anal + caudal

pectoral_mid.label: 2-D cut of the 3-D mesh. Flow on it is a 2-D proxy, not 3-D aerodynamics of the fish.
pectoral_mid.plane: pectoral_L, 50% of exposed semispan, normal along the fin span (dihedral removed)

planform.label: 2-D cut of the 3-D mesh. Flow on it is a 2-D proxy, not 3-D aerodynamics of the fish.
planform.plane: projection onto z = 0 of body + pectorals + pelvics (top view)
